parameters.name: CheckpointPauseTime
parameters.description:
The duration for which the task is paused when a checkpoint is reached.
- Unit: minutes.
- Valid values: 1 to 2880.
- Default value: 60.

parameters.name: Checkpoints
parameters.description: The checkpoints for the refresh task. When the percentage of new instances reaches the specified value, the task is automatically paused for the duration specified by CheckpointPauseTime.

sub_parameters.name: Percentage
sub_parameters.description:
The percentage of new instances to total instances in the scaling group at which the task is automatically paused. Valid values: 1 to 100 (%).

> The values must be specified in ascending order, and the last percentage value must be 100.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

parameters.name: DesiredConfiguration
parameters.description:
The desired configuration for the instance refresh.

> - You cannot specify ScalingConfigurationId, ImageId, LaunchTemplateId, and Containers at the same time. You must specify one of them.
- The refresh task skips instances in the scaling group that already match the desired configuration.

parameters.name: MaxHealthyPercentage
parameters.description:
The maximum percentage by which the number of instances in the scaling group can exceed the scaling group capacity during the instance refresh. Valid values: 100 to 200. Default value: 120.

> If you set both MinHealthyPercentage and MaxHealthyPercentage to 100, one instance is refreshed at a time.

parameters.name: MinHealthyPercentage
parameters.description: The minimum percentage of instances that must remain in service in the scaling group during the instance refresh. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 80.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: SkipMatching
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip instances that match the desired configuration.

> The system determines whether an instance matches based on the ID of the desired scaling configuration, not by comparing specific configuration items.

Valid values:

- true: Instances that were already created with the desired configuration are skipped.
- false: All instances in the scaling group are refreshed when the instance refresh task starts.

Default value: true.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The execution strategy for the instance refresh task. Valid values:

* Rolling: refreshes instances by creating new instances and releasing old instances.
* ReplaceSystemDisk: updates the system cloud disk of existing instances by specifying DesiredConfiguration.image.

Default value: Rolling.
